text: Wellbore drilled to total depth of 8675-ft MD, 8321-ft TVD with 16.3 ppg mud. A 5 1/2-inch production liner was run to TD with TOL at 7689-ft. Initial completion operations were performed with a mudline tree. Wellbore completed as a single, GP gas completion in the BN 8400-ft Sand with perforations from 8400-8430-ft and 8439-8453-ft MD.

Stone Energy successfully completed zone change operations on ST 164, OCS-G-01250, Well C-15ST2.  Operations began on August 2, 2009, and ended on August 5, 2009.  The previous producing interval, the "Tex-X-1" Sand, perfs 14425' - 14470' MD, was isolated by setting a MRBP @ 14345' MD and setting ~52' of cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 14293' MD.  The "D-2" Sand was then exposed to production by perforating from 13633' - 13640' MD & 13562' - 13569' MD.

The subsequent report for the approved EOR to TA the well stipulates that the casings would be cut 15' BML and pulled during platform removal.  The attached Salvage report shows September 11, 2004 as the date casings were cut and pulled.

Wash sand with a coil tbg unit, install a thru-tbg gravel pack, wash proppant from atop the vented, gravel pack screen using a coil tbg unit and spotted acid into perforations to stimulate productivity.

Zone change operations were successfully completed on EW 306, Well A-3ST3.  Operations began on May 9, 2010 and were completed on May 25, 2010.  The previous producing interval, the "LH" Sand, perfs 16310' - 16328' MD, was isolated by setting a MRBP @ 16295' MD and dumping 50' of cmt on top of the plug; ETOC @ 16245' MD.  The "LG Lwr" Sand was then exposed to production by perforating from 16167' - 16175' MD.

Leed has successfully completed perforation modification operations on the SS 201 A06 well, "KH" Sand completion to reduce water production.  

A MRBP was set at 12901' MD.   Resin and cement was dumped on top of the plug with the ETOC cement @ 12853' MD.  The operation successfully isolated the bottom portion of the "KH" Sand completion, perforation interval 12853' - 12896' MD.

Operations began on 01-31-11 and were completed on 02-04-11.

Stone has completed zone change operations on the VR 51 A-4 well to produce the "CC-1" sand. The previous completion, the "C01" sand, was isolated by pulling the 3-1/2" tubing string at 12,080' MD, setting a CIBP in the casing at 12,075' MD, and dumping 50' of cement on top of the plug, w/ ETOC at 12,025' MD. The "CC-1" sand was perforated at intervals 10,382'-10,392' MD. A CIBP was set at 10,399' MD and GP assy was set on top of CIBP. The "CC-1" sand was then gravel packed. Coil tubing was then utilized to perform an acid job on the well and jet the well with nitrogen to lift the well allowing for production to be established from the "CC-1" Sand. Operations began 03/25/2011 and ended 05/04/2011.

Stone has successfully completed operations on the EW 306 A-16 well to install a subsurface safety PB insert valve in the X-nipple at 471' MD to convert the operation of the downhole safety valve to subsea control. This has allowed for production to be restored from the well. Operations began and ended on 04/27/2011.

See attached file, Current Wellbore Schematic for details.

Stone has successfully completed perforation modification operation on the EC 121 B-1 well. Perforations were added to the lower lobe of the current completion, the "Cyclam 3-B" sand at intervals 9,996'-10,006' MD. Operations began and ended on 05/22/2011.

Unable to Pressure test the surface plug, bubble tested and weight tested 3/16/11, but when pressure testing a hole blew out through the 10 ¾? and 20? somewhere between mud line and water line. Could not pressure test.

Stone has successfully completed operations on the EW 306 A-14ST1 well to convert the well from flowing to  a gas lift well. The previously installed gas lift valves were activated and utilized to produce the well via gas lift operations.   The results of the operations have reclassified the well from producing oil well (POW) to oil gas lift (OGL).  Operations began 08/23/11 and ended 08/25/11.

Stone has successfully drilled and completed for production the SS 112 OCS-00066, Well Q1ST2.  The well was spud on 10-06-11 by cutting a window in the 7 5/8" csg at 5678' MD.  Operations were completed on 11-08-11.

The well was drilled to TD, 9475' / 9357' TVD on 10-12-11 w/a MW of 10.0 ppg.  A 5" 18#/ft, P-110 production liner was set from 5395' MD to TD.  

The well was completed for production as a single, GP, oil completion in the "R-3" Sand with perforations of 9182' - 9208' MD / 9073' - 9098' TVD.

Stone Energy Corporation has successfully completed operations on the MC 109 Well No. A012ST01 to install live gas lift valves in the well to convert to a gas lift oil well. Operations began 01/08/2012 and ended 01/31/2012.

Well was batch set (through the 22" casing) and suspended on 04/19/2012, pending further operations.
On 05/31/2012, tagged cement @ 8,694'. Apply 20k weight test down. Displaced well to 12.2 ppg mud with corrosion inhibitor. Install 30" TA Cap and inject McDermid fluid in TA Cap.

Well was batch set (through the 22" casing) and suspended on 05/02/2012, pending further operations.
On 05/31/2012, tagged cement @ 8,697'. Apply 20k weight test down. Displaced well to 12.2 ppg mud with corrosion inhibitor. Install 30" TA Cap and inject McDermid fluid in TA Cap.

Due to the fact that this well was previously classified as PA?d by a previous operator in 1975 McMoRan is not aware of the dates the cement plugs were placed on this well.  This well was actually PA?d by McMoRan on 05/15/2012 all casings cut @ 20-ft BML.

Slight intermittent bubbles were observed emanating from the annuli.   A slip on intervention well cap was installed. Micro-Matrix Cement was injected to stop bubbling. No bubbles observed.

Please note: The 30", 13 3/8" and 9 5/8" casings / conductors were cut at 186' AML.

The approved APM was to change zones; however, after further geological review, it was determined that the new perfs were in the same zone, resulting in a modification to perforations in current zone.

Anadarko received approval for a 14 day temporary zone change/test for EB 646 SS007 ST01. The DS-1 FB A sand was temporarily isolated and only the DS-1 FB A sand was produced temporarily. 

The isolation resulted in a loss of oil and an increase in water after production. Therefore the test was ended early and the well was returned to the pre-test configuration with both the DS-1 FB A and DP-1 FB A open. Both the district and region were notified.

*Per the approved APM comments Anadarko was required to return the wellbore to the commingled DP-1/DS-1 completion at the end of the test period unless written permission was granted by both the district and the region to do otherwise. This was also discussed with Mark Osterman prior to sleeve shift back to the commingled configuration.

The Mad Dog batch set drilling operations installed 36" conductor and 22" surface casing in Green Canyon Block 782. The batch set wells include MD12, MD15, MD16, MD17 and MD18, respectively.  Batch set operations started on September 25, 2013 and concluded on December 21, 2013 with all of the batch set wells status drilling suspended.  The Mad Dog Spar Rig was used for the batch set operation, no BOPs were used during any part of the batch set since all operations were open water.

Zone change operations have been completed on the EC 36 Well A-1 to produce the "Cris I M-7" Sd (S02). The "Cris I M-8" Sd (S01) existing perfs of 9,934'-9,945' MD (9,367'-9,378' TVD) were isolated by setting a MRBP at 9,891' RKB + 10' cmt (ETOC 9,881' RKB); pressure tested to 1050 psi. The "Cris I M-7" Sd was open to production by shifting sliding sleeves at 9,754' & 9,772' MD open. Operations began 01/09/2015 and ended 01/18/2015.

The "Cris R" Sand perfs (16,862'-16,877' MD) were sqz'd w/ 4.8 bbls (40.5 sxs, 43.7 cu ft) Class H cmt w/ TOC at 16,310' pressure tested to 1000 psi. A 300' cmt plug was set in the 7-5/8" csg & 7-5/8" x 13-5/8" annulus w/39 bbls (203 sxs, 219 cu ft) Class H Cmt w/TOC at 1170' MD (1010' BML) & pressure tested to 1000 psi. 

The 7-5/8" csg was perf'd @ 991' RKB. A 13-5/8" csg CIBP was set @ 700' MD (600'BML).  The 13-5/8" csg was perf'd 695'-697'. Operation to perform the zonal testing required in the DC132
commingling agreement. The first step was to close the upper M57 zone and perform the single zone M55 well test. The second step was to close the lower M55 zone and open the upper M57 zone to perform the single zone M57 well test. The third step was to open the lower M55 zone and return to commingling production from both zones after conducting the single zone well tests. These activities was completed between February 12th to February 14th.

Stone has successfully performed a zone change operation on the PL 23 OCS G-01238, Well No. C-001ST to produce the CP27 Sand.  Operations began on May 28, 2007 and were completed on June 3, 2007. The previous producing interval in the well, the CP28 Sand was isolated by setting a Posi-set Plug @ 15080' & dumping 32' of cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 15048'.  The 5" liner was perforated @ 14912' - 14954' for production.

Well is currently in TA status. The 2-7/8" tubing, 7" and 9-5/8" casings have been cut and pulled. The 13-3/8" casing and 26" drive pipe are cut at 4" AML and will be cut at minimum of 15' BML and recovered at platform abandonment.

The well was successfuly completed as a single, gravel packed, oil completion in the "Big 2 1-B" Sand. Completion operations were completed on 08-23-07.

The EI 183 A6BP2 wellbore was spud on December 19, 2007 at a depth of 14219' MD and the wellbore was TD'd on December 30, 2007 at a depth of 15612' Md / 14648' TVD.  Due to lost returns, the wellbore was plugged back and abandoned on January 11, 2008 to drill the EI 183 A6BP3 wellbore.

Completed as a single stacked gravel packed completion in the Lower KJ/KK Sand with an unperforated selective in the LP Sand.  The Lower KJ/KK Sand will only be produced at this time.  A zone change could be submitted at a later date to commingle the sands.

Also please note:  The KJ/KK Sand is hooked up and ready to flow.  Due to Hurricane Ike, the well is temporarily shut-in.

Stone performed zone change operations on the PL 23, OCS-G-01238, Well C4ST1BP1 to produce the "CP 28" Sand.  Operations began on August 18, 2008, and were completed on September 30, 2008. The previous producing interval, the "CP 29" Sand was isolated by setting a posi-set plug @ 15310' MD and dumping 25' cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 15285'.  

The "CP 28" Sand was exposed to production by perforating from 15180' - 15192' MD.  The well was turned over to production on October 1, 2008; however, the "CP 28" watered out and did not produce at economic levels.  Test results for October 2, 2008:  38 MCFPD, 0 BCPD, 1600 BWPD.  A Notice of 1st Production is not being filed for the "CP 28" Sand completion interval.  The well is shut-in while waiting for zone change operations to be completed to produce the "CP24" Sand.
